title: German Beef Wrap
description: A hearty beef wrap with a German twist, featuring a delicious blend of spices and flavors.

ingredients.name: Beef Striploin Steak
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality beef for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Kissed German Mustard
ingredients.notes: A sweet and tangy mustard that adds depth to the dish

ingredients.name: Nutty Caraway Seeds
ingredients.notes: Caraway seeds have a distinctive nutty flavor and aroma

ingredients.name: Thai Basil Leaves
ingredients.notes: Add a pop of freshness with Thai basil leaves

instructions: 1. Slice the beef striploin steak into thin strips and season with salt, pepper, and caraway seeds.
2. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the beef. Cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
3. In a small bowl, mix together the kissed German mustard, salt, and pepper. Brush the mustard mixture onto the cooked beef.
4. Warm the wrap in the oven or in a dry skillet.
5. Assemble the wrap by placing the beef onto the wrap, followed by a few Thai basil leaves.
